notes.title: Dev update - bhop timer, UI system, and some notes
notes.notes: [p]I've been on vacation since mid-June, but it hasn't stopped me from working on Worldspawn. Since June I've made considerable progress on the user interface system, and began work on the official bunnyhop timer gamemode. This blog will cover recent improvements to Worldspawn as well as dig into the systems and decision making behind them.[/p][p][/p][h2]User Interface[/h2][p]The Worldspawn UI is a completely custom HTML/SCSS renderer—no embedded Chromium or off-the-shelf framework here. Every step, from parsing HTML and SCSS to drawing panels and text, is hand-rolled, and every draw call is pushed straight to the GPU for high performance.[/p][p]Over the last few weeks, I've overhauled our stylesheet engine with performance in mind. Under the hood, each computed style is packed into one contiguous, blittable struct—so applying cascades, toggling states, or updating styles is just a single memcpy away. The result? Styling operations that are practically free and unload your CPU for more important work.[/p][p]On top of that, I’ve added full support for background and border gradients, image rendering, CSS transforms, and even dropped in a vector-based text renderer as a future path beyond SDF text. All of which means more visual polish, more dynamic layouts, and tons of room to customize your HUD exactly how you like it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660233/8d6e9a7c68810e384209c5e5a176b02c526b2f3b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660233/4624699a7405e2507f048e7ebc09fba7fdb42af8.png"][/img][/p][h3]Why html/scss?[/h3][p]I love that anyone can jump in, tweak the interface, or grab a community-made UI kit to personalize their speedrunning setup. HTML and SCSS form a familiar, flexible foundation for building UIs—so swapping fonts, updating color schemes, or adding and removing HUD elements is effortless.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bhop Timer[/h2][p]I’ve begun work on the bhop timer. You can now browse and play over 10,000 bunnyhop maps collected and created throughout bhop’s history. We also include official zone data for many of these maps, so they’re ready to run instantly.[/p][p]My top priority is making movement match Counter-Strike: Source one-to-one. Running bh_aztec in a CS:S server or in Worldspawn feels identical—so if you set a world record here, it’s unquestionably valid.[/p][p]BSP maps receive first-class support as well. Loading and converting Source Engine maps is equally important, meaning a 64 in CS:S is the same as a 64 in Worldspawn.[/p][p]There’s still work to do on BSP rendering, but the foundation is solid. Most maps load and play correctly now, though a few visual glitches and bugs remain to be ironed out.[/p][p]Later on, I look forward to writing up a blog about the technical specs of BSP and movement/physics in CS:S. I've done a lot of research around this to replicate gameplay perfectly, and much of it you won't find easily on the web, some of it is quite interesting![/p][p][/p][h2]Store Page[/h2][p]Worldspawn's Steam store page is public marked as Coming Soon. We will roll out invites to friends & Discord members first, then users who have Worldspawn wishlisted, then finally enter open beta where anybody can play and test, and ultimately, a full release. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/worldspawn" style="button" buttoncolor="#7289da"]Worldspawn Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Memento from me[/h2][p]I started building games back in 2015/2016 with the goal of creating a true standalone surf & bunnyhop experience. Worldspawn is the culmination of everything I’ve learned since then. Building an engine from the ground up—where movement is perfect and every surf and bhop map ever made just works—is essential. This isn’t a modern remix or a gimmick; here, bunnyhop and surf are front and center, not an afterthought.[/p][p]Future updates will only refine and enhance movement, never break it. Once the core experience is rock-solid, we can explore new gameplay ideas. And no matter what device you’re on—Windows, Linux, iOS, tablets, phones, even your smart fridge—you’ll be able to surf and bhop without compromise.[/p][p][/p][p]❤️ Crayz[/p]

notes.title: Built Purely for Bhop & Surf
notes.notes: [p]There's a specific feeling dedicated movement players chase. It's the seamless flow, the crisp strafes, the perfect boarding of a surf ramp. For too long, this experience has existed as a sub-genre, a mod, or a happy accident within games built for other purposes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Worldspawn changes that.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This isn't an adaptation or an afterthought. Worldspawn is a standalone platform, created from the ground up with a single focus: to deliver the definitive bhop and surf experience. It's about capturing that authentic feel we love, rebuilt on a dedicated, modern foundation.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why a Dedicated Platform? Because the Purity of Movement Demands It.[/h2][p][/p][p]Players familiar with bhop and surf understand the nuances. They know the frustration of inconsistent physics when a base game updates, the limitations of modding tools, or the performance compromises that come from an engine not designed for this specific, high-skill gameplay.[/p][list][*][p][b]The Problem with "Good Enough":[/b] When movement mechanics are secondary, they're often the first to be affected by broader game changes or engine limitations. What feels perfect one day can feel subtly [i]off[/i] the next.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Constraints of Modding:[/b] While the community has achieved incredible things with mods, they are, by nature, constrained by the host game's architecture.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Need for Focus:[/b] Worldspawn aims to provide a stable, reliable environment.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Worldspawn is being built on a [b]custom game engine[/b]. The goal is to replicate the beloved movement and mechanics of classic Source engine experiences as closely as possible, while leveraging the advantages of modern technology.[/p][p]This dedicated approach means:[/p][list][*][p][b]Authentic Physics:[/b] Carefully tuned movement mechanics designed to feel intuitively [i]right[/i]. No compromises or approximations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized Performance:[/b] Smooth, consistent frame rates and low-latency input are necessities for movement gaming. Worldspawn is being built to deliver a responsive edge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Standalone Freedom & Consistency:[/b] Independent from other games means no conflicting updates. Just pure, focused gameplay, today and tomorrow.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Experience the Difference: A Platform for Players and Creators[/h2][p][/p][p]Worldspawn is more than just physics; it's an ecosystem designed to support and grow the movement community.[/p][list][*][p][b]Endless Maps:[/b] Expect a continually expanding library of community creations, with first-class support for all the classics such as bhop_arcane, surf_lt_omnific, bhop_monster_jam.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Compete & Improve:[/b] Integrated leaderboards, precision timers, and replay systems will allow players to track their progress, chase records, and learn from the best.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Empower Creators with Modern Tools:[/b] Worldspawn will provide mappers with the tools to build more complex, highly optimized, and creatively ambitious experiences than ever before. Less fighting with old limitations, more unleashing creativity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tailor Your View:[/b] Customize your HUD, visual settings, and controls. Get the information and feel you need for optimal performance and personal preference.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This is a platform built with a deep understanding and respect for the movement community. It’s about providing a dedicated home where creativity can be unleashed and the joy of bhop and surf can be experienced without compromise.[/p][p][/p][p]The journey is underway.  Toss Worldspawn in your wishlist and keep in touch.[/p][p]Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/worldspawn" style="button" buttoncolor="#5865f2"]https://discord.gg/worldspawn[/url][/p][p]Website:[/p][p][url="https://worldspawn.gg" style="button"]https://worldspawn.gg[/url][/p]
